==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' 
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 18 matches
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
**1st to 6th place will play the playoffs
***1st and 2nd place are seeded into Semifinals
***3rd and 4th place are seeded into Quarterfinals, facing top 2 teams from [[LCO/2023/Split 1|LCO Split 1]]
***5th and 6th place are seeded into Losers' Round 1
* '''Playoffs''' 
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2023|Mid-Season Invitational 2023]]
